text: Planning a trip is half the fun, from choosing destinations to booking flights. When you finally arrive, the real adventure begins. Experiencing new cultures is eye-opening, whether it’s visiting ancient temples or watching a local festival. Of course, food is a highlight—tasting street snacks or a home-cooked meal can be unforgettable. Sometimes, language barriers create funny moments, like when I accidentally ordered a fish dish instead of chicken, but we solved it with hand gestures and smiles. These challenges make the journey memorable. In the end, the best souvenirs aren’t objects; they’re the stories and memories you carry home, ones that stay with you long after the tan fades.
